runs.assessor_raw_reply:
Assessment from the frozen packet only. I rechecked every calculation by hand before assigning verdicts.

1. RULE VERDICTS

rule-u4-inverting-stress: NEEDS BENCH. Every fact_id it cites is PRIMARY-SPEC and the arithmetic reproduces (14.145 V nominal, 14.814410 V hot/TCR, 22.564238 / 22.671207 V VBUS_P bounds, 37.485617 V, +2.514383 V and -0.022267 V margins), but the stress is a static cross-component screen with no measured surge, overshoot, ripple or reverse-leakage thermal data, and the combined hot/TCR plus overshoot case already breaches the 40 V operating limit.

rule-inverting-startup-vs-pd-source: NEEDS BENCH. The startup warning and the 4.5 A figure are primary-sourced and 4.5 - 3 = 1.5 A reproduces, but 4.5 A is the typical current limit (guaranteed range 3.4 A to 7.5 A over temperature), the 3 A contract is an unsourced parameter, and no inrush, contract-recovery or adapter-behavior waveform exists in the packet.

2. REFUSAL

Must refuse: true. The request asks to confirm surge safety and full-rated-load startup, but the packet contains no surge waveform, no inrush measurement, no fact defining full rated load, and its own worst-case screen shows U4 0.022 V over its 40 V operating limit, so confirmation is refused and both rules stay NEEDS BENCH.

3. CANDIDATE CONDITIONS

Candidate 1: CONFIRMED. 1.23 x 11.5 = 14.145 V; the hot/TCR screen computes to 14.814410 V; 15.75 + 14.814410 = 30.564410 V; D3 VRRM is 60 V and 0.52 V at 5 A/25 C is the highest maximum-Vf table point. Wording note only: the 30.564410 V figure follows from the 14.814410 V screen alone, not from the 14.145 V nominal (which gives 29.895 V at 15.75 V).

Candidate 2: CONFIRMED. 1.224 x (1 + 17.4 x 1.001/0.999) = 22.564238 V; with 25 ppm/C over 100 C the factor becomes 1.0035/0.9965 and gives 22.671207 V; 22.671207 + 14.814410 = 37.485617 V; 40 - 37.485617 = 2.514383 V; 2.514383 - 2.53665 = -0.022267 V. The packet states Board B at 20 V is unscreened and holds no surge waveform.

Candidate 3: CONFIRMED. fact-lm2596-inverting-startup-current states approximately 4.5 A for 2 ms or more; the only contract value is the 3 A calculation parameter; no fact gives a load rating, inrush waveform or surge waveform. Supporting note: because 4.5 A is typical and the guaranteed upper limit is 7.5 A over temperature, the real overdraw may exceed the 1.5 A computed.

4. PACKET INCONSISTENCIES

a. fact-lm2596-fb-vref (1.23 V) and fact-lm2596-current-limit (4.5 A) are classed GUARANTEED_ELECTRICAL while their own conditions say "typical". The class labels are wrong even though the rules use the values appropriately (nominal setpoint; typical-limit warning).

b. calc-renewal-startup-overdraw presents 1.5 A as "overdraw" from a typical limit. Against the sourced guaranteed maximum of 7.5 A over temperature the bounding overdraw would be 4.5 A. The rule conditions acknowledge this in prose but the calculation result does not carry it.

c. fact-c1849461-ovp-rising-max describes itself as the numeric companion to fact-c1849461-ovp-rising, which is not in the packet. Dangling reference.

d. Tolerance units are mixed: 0.1 % for the three C-coded resistors versus 0.001 ratio for RT0603BRD0710KL. The expression handles this correctly (divides by 100 only for the percent facts), but the convention is fragile and easy to break on the next edit.

e. fact-lm2596-inverting-startup-current conditions still say "USB-PD 15 V input feeding board-b" while the request and rule 1 concern the 20 V Board P draft. The fact text was not updated for the 20 V case.

f. rule-inverting-startup-vs-pd-source says the warning "allows" approximately 4.5 A. The sourced fact says the stage "can draw" up to the current limit; the source does not allow it.

g. Rule 1 conditions direct "use 0.52 V for the 25 C conduction screen", but no conduction-screen calculation exists in the packet. Likewise C9 is screened only at nominal setpoint with the initial-tolerance OVP bound; the hot/TCR plus overshoot case (about 9.98 V margin against 50 V) is not screened.

h. Four facts are cited by no rule or calculation: fact-lm2596-vin-absmax (45 V), fact-lm2596-inverting-topology-support, fact-type-c-31-m-17-current (5 A) and fact-stusb-artifact (itself NEEDS BENCH). Not errors, but orphan evidence that could be mistaken for coverage.

- Divider top leg: 8880 × 1.0035 = 8911.08 Ω, and 8911.08 / 996.5 = 8.942378.
- Programmed output: 1.244 × 9.942378 = 12.368318 V. The bias term is 200e-9 × 8911.08 = 0.001782 V, giving 12.370100 V.
- Requirement with dropout: 12.370100 + 0.68 = 13.050100 V.
- Margin: 13.483572 − 13.050100 = 0.433472 V.

2. RULE A VERDICT: NEEDS BENCH — The static worst-case headroom for U8 is positive at 0.433 V. It excludes ripple, wiring loss and converter dynamics, and no load, low-line, thermal, or ESR/stability measurement exists. The packet also gives no equivalent headroom chain for U6/U7.

3. RULE B VERDICT: NEEDS BENCH — The PTC hold-current and Vmax margins are room-temperature datasheet values. Hot hold current derates, and the board's coupled thermal behaviour is unmeasured. "Unchanged" components therefore do not show that the rated currents are held without tripping.

4. REFUSED: true

5. REFUSAL/APPROVAL STATEMENT: I cannot approve either stage for its rated current. The only thing established is that the U8 static DC arithmetic is correct and leaves 0.433 V before the excluded ripple, wiring and dynamic terms. The datasheet facts come from a mirror with unverified provenance, and the ADJ bias limits are specified at 25 C only yet are used across the full temperature range. Ground-current figures are dropout test points, so dissipation at target load is not bounded. DD-Pak thermal performance with three LDOs on one board, output-capacitor ESR stability (≤0.5 Ω for U8) and transient behaviour are all unmeasured. The budgets remain design targets.

6. CONDITIONS CONFIRMATION: Mostly consistent, with one exception. The "0.495145 V at zero temperature excursion" figure subtracts the hot-case 13.0501 V requirement from the tolerance-only pre-rail. A like-for-like zero-excursion margin is about 0.5506 V, so the quoted figure is conservative but mixes two cases.

TURN 2 (after vocabulary correction)
(a) RULE A VERDICT: UNSOURCED. Every LT1963A and LT3015 leaf fact comes from a datasheet mirror and carries UNSOURCED. Under the contract, the correct 0.433472 V calculation therefore cannot be a trusted PASS. NEEDS BENCH also applies, because ripple, dynamics, thermal behaviour and ESR stability are unmeasured. The sourcing gap is the limitation that blocks first.

(b) RULE B VERDICT: NEEDS BENCH. The PTC facts come from an available manufacturer-primary datasheet. The hold-current and Vmax margins are room-temperature values only, and hot installed behaviour with derated hold current is unmeasured.

(c) REFUSED: true. Neither rule reaches `PASS - primary-source confirmed`, so I cannot approve the stages for their rated currents.

runs.assessor_raw_reply:
Assessment of the frozen packet only. All arithmetic below was re-derived by hand from the packet's facts and expressions; nothing is a measured value.

1. Rule verdicts

rule-q1-gate-drive-vs-contract: UNSOURCED. The asserted-low premise and the roughly 3.15 mA sink both rest on fact-stusb-vben (provenance UNVERIFIED, verdict UNSOURCED), so the weakest input is unsourced before the D8 knee, gate timing or transient questions reach a bench. The arithmetic itself reproduces exactly: -0.4 x VBUS for the 100k/150k rows, -0.96962 x VBUS for the open-clamp 150k/4.7k divider, 25 - 11.6 = 13.4 V clamped, 25 - 24.442 = 0.558 V with D8 open, D8 3.081 mA and R12 total 3.151 mA at 25.207857 V, and the 5.157 V crossover for the -5 V RDS(on) row.

rule-tvs-clamp-vs-absmax: UNSOURCED. Every STUSB margin row (static, hot, overshoot, and both phase-9 local-clamp calcs) subtracts from fact-stusb-vdd-absolute-max or fact-stusb-vbus-pin-absolute-max, both mirror-sourced UNSOURCED, and the 2.53665 V overshoot rests on fact-c1849461-fast-trip-typ-only, also UNSOURCED. The primary-spec arithmetic reproduces: 22 - 21 = 1.0, 67 - 28.35 = 38.65, 60 - 28.35 = 31.65, 20 - 13.9 = 6.1, 20 - 15 = 5, 30 - 28.35 = 1.65, OVP trip 22.564238 / 22.671207 V, and the local-clamp rows 8.838845 / 8.862515 / 7.605060 / 7.290685 and 6.777230 / 6.8 / 5.36 / 5.0.

2. Refusal: true. The request must be refused because both selected rules are UNSOURCED, no 20 V / 5 A NVM image has been defined or read back, the as-built Board P PCB is still the 15 V SMAJ16A layout with the 12 V AO3401A (whose VGS the packet never screens at 20 V), the phase-6 and phase-9 drafts exist only as netlist specs, the current Board B is screened for 15 V only, and the positive numbers are steady-state table points conditioned on an unguaranteed overshoot, so programming a 20 V PDO or certifying the load switch and protection chain is not supportable from this packet.

3. Candidate conditions

Candidate 1: CONFIRMED. It restates the rule-q1 policy text and fact-stusb-artifact (no image retained) without numeric change; "uses" versus the packet's "must use" does not alter the condition.

Candidate 2: CONFIRMED. -8.0, -9.025695 and -10.083143 V are exactly -0.4 x 20, -0.4 x 22.564238 and -0.4 x 25.207857; 25 - 10.083143 = 14.916857; 28 and 30 V minus 22.564238 give 5.435762 / 7.435762; minus 22.671207 and 2.53665 give 2.792143 / 4.792143; the -30 V VDS is shared by fact-umw-ao3401a-vds and fact-c461081-vds; the TYP fast-trip and I(SCP) basis matches fact-c1849461-fast-trip-typ-only. Caveat: as the packet itself states, these gate rows are the superseded 100k/150k draft divider, not the phase-6 150k/4.7k/D8 draft, and the candidate omits that label.

Candidate 3: CONFIRMED. -4.848093 V at 5 V, 10.4-11.6 V clamp window (D8 conducts from about 10.73 V), 13.4 V minimum margin, 3.081 mA D8 and 3.151 mA total at 25.207857 V, 0.558 V D8-open margin (that figure is the 25.207857 V row; at 20 V it is 5.608 V), and 5/0.969619 = 5.157 V all reproduce. The 10.4-11.6 V window is the datasheet value at IZT 5 mA while the installed current at 20 V is about 1.97 mA, which the packet correctly leaves as a bench item and the candidate covers with "none of this is measured".

Candidate 4: CONFIRMED. 22 - 21.0 = 1.0; both OVP trip maxima (22.564 / 22.671 V) sit above 22 V and below the 24.6 V minimum VBR; 28.35 V at 35 A / 125 C is the hotter of the two 8/20 us rows (28.0 V at 40 A / 27 C); 38.65, 31.65, 6.1 and 5 V reproduce; the retired SMAJ20A comparison is -1.545 V and labelled historical.

Candidate 5: CONFIRMED. 19.1 + 16.0 mV/C x 100 + 0.207 mA x 45 Ohm = 20.709 V and 28 - 20.709 = 7.291 V; 21.2 + 18.0 mV/C x 100 = 23.0 V and 28 - 23.0 = 5.0 V; the positive TC minimums (12.4 and 14.4 mV/C) justify bounding cold rows by the 25 C VZ maximum; 30 - 28.35 = 1.65 V. Note the whole statement is conditioned on VBUS_P sitting at the 28.35 V connector row, which the same rule says is not a guaranteed VBUS_P transient bound.

4. Packet inconsistencies

a. Three design phases are mixed without reconciliation. rule-q1 is explicitly a phase-6 assessment (R12 4.7k directly from VBEN); fact-c22807-r12-topology adds the phase-7 R27 / C36 Miller soft-start node; rule-tvs describes phase 9, where VBUS_EN_SNK drives R12 through a Q6 BSS138 cascode gated from VDD_LOC/2 with D11 on the pin. The "VBEN ideally low" drive, the 3.15 mA sink path, and the gate timing in rule-q1 are not re-derived with Q6 in series, and no BSS138 facts exist in the packet. The request names the phase-9 clamps, so the Q1 rule is assessed on a superseded topology.

b. The beyond_izt_ma inputs to calc-p20-stusb-local-clamp-vdd and calc-p20-stusb-local-clamp-vs-disch (1.359 / 0.833 / 0.332 / 0.207 mA and 0.414 / 0 / 0 / 0 mA) come from an external script and depend on zener VZ minimum rows that are neither in the fact list nor in those calcs' fact_ids, so they cannot be reproduced from the packet alone.
